fact.thing: uninvested cash from a $100 three-way ETF split
fact.box: a TFSA or RRSP at a broker that only sells whole shares
fact.claim: On Nov 4, 2026 one share cost CAD 45.40 for XEQT, $61.76 for VEQT and $190.40 for VFV on the funds' own pages. Split $100 three ways and each slice is $33.33, which is less than one share of any of them, so at a broker that only sells whole shares the entire $100 sits in cash and buys nothing. Put the same $100 into XEQT alone and it buys 2 shares for $90.80, leaving $9.20 uninvested. The exception is brokers that sell fractional shares, such as Wealthsimple, where the three-way split invests the full amount; share prices also change daily, so the leftover changes with them.
